title: VibeCoder joins the creative app listings
summary:
A community coding app joined the showcase, while the API docs got clearer about local images and text completions.

VibeCoder, a community web app for coding without writing syntax, was added to the README and website app lists.

The API docs now show how to send a local JPEG as a base64 data URL in Python and JavaScript, alongside the existing image-URL approach.

The docs clarify that the OpenAI-compatible text API currently supports only the completion endpoint.
